description: A form or dashboard: a whole layout, then operations run in order. Each part is skipped when the form already has it, so the same spec can be sent again. A form that does not exist is created from its layout.

solution.description: Unique name of the unmanaged solution the form goes into.

table.description: Table logical name. Not for a dashboard.

form.description: The form's or dashboard's name, for example Information.

formType.description: Default main. dashboard is a system dashboard of lists and charts.

description.description: For a new form or dashboard.

layout.description: The whole layout: these tabs in this order, each with these sections and fields. Tabs and sections left out are taken off the form; a field keeps its control, label and settings when it is already on the form, and subgrids and web resources already in a kept section stay at its end.

name.description: The tab's name; an existing tab matches by name.

label.description: Default: the current label, or the name for a new tab.

name.description: The section's name; an existing section matches by name, in any tab.

label.description: Default: the current label, or the name for a new section.

column.description: Which column of the tab the section is in, 1 to 3. Default 1.

fields.description: Column logical names, one per row, in order. Not for dashboards.

components.description: Dashboards only: the charts and lists in this section, in order.

items.description: A list or chart on a dashboard: a public view of a table, shown as a grid, or with a system chart of the table.

name.description: The component's name, unique on the dashboard.

view.description: A public view of the table. Default: its default public view.

chart.description: A system chart of the table. With it the component shows the chart.

items.description: addField/moveField: column into section (after a column). removeField: column. addSection: section into tab. addTab: tab. setLabel/setVisible: on column, else section, else tab. addSubgrid: name, subgridTable into section. addLibrary/removeLibrary: library. addHandler/removeHandler: event (column for onchange), library, function. Tabs and sections match by name or label.

label.description: Label in the base language. For a new tab or section, its label.

after.description: Place it after this column (fields), section (addSection) or tab (addTab). Default: at the end.

subgridTable.description: addSubgrid: the table the subgrid lists.

relationship.description: addSubgrid: schema name of the relationship; without it the subgrid lists all records.

view.description: addSubgrid: name of a public view of subgridTable. Default: its default view.

library.description: Name of a JavaScript web resource, for example con_/project/form.js.

function.description: addHandler: the function to call, for example Contoso.Project.onLoad.

parameters.description: addHandler: comma-separated parameters passed to the function.

passContext.description: addHandler: pass the execution context as the first parameter. Default true.
